reviews.title: Yoga Go Has Changed My Life
reviews.text: I started Yoga Go going on 2 years this January. I am 67 and have Chronic Fatigue Syndrome, Inflammatory Arthritis, Fibromyalgia and too many other diagnoses to put here.  Even though I had 3 surgeries the first year, and wasn’t able to do Yoga everyday because of recovery restrictions, Yoga Go definitely impacted my recovery. Walking around the house was exhausting and it was difficult to breathe. I was able to go to a concert last week and I was able to dance for the first time  in decades! 50 minutes! I am slowly losing weight and am learning how to play the piano and Spanish.   I am volunteering and socializing. I believe that Yoga Go has been a major part of getting my life back.

reviews.title: A Plan Worth Doing Daily
reviews.text:
It’s been decades since I found a fitness video I could stick with daily.
This Tai Chi  streaming app program brought me back to a daily practice.
Since my knees became severely arthritic I could not do a Yoga routine anymore.  Even a Tai Chi class I attended was too hard for my knees to do.
This app program is doable even if you have knees as bad as mine!
Many poses can be done seated.
  My only criticism is that you have to interpret the pose viewed as the opposite side from the teacher’s image. It would be easier to follow if the teacher called out the opposite side from his to activate.  I’ve had other instructors who have done this and it made the posture easier to follow.

reviews.title: Daily user
reviews.text: I started using this app almost daily about 9 months ago. I have never really enjoyed exercise and everyone has always recommended yoga. This app is phenomenal. It has made me fall in love with yoga. Now on the days I skip, I miss it! The Practice section is great because I can just pick the length of time I want to go for and just do that without having to think. The only real feedback I have is that it would be nice to be able to “favorite” specific workouts - there are two from one of the 28 day series I did that I would literally do every day if I could just open the app and pick those specific days’ and workouts. Otherwise, this app has been a life changer. I am so much more flexible and mobile, and combined with walking every day, I have learned that there is a way to lose weight and feel healthier that I actually REALLY enjoy.

am extremely disappointed with this app. I discovered that I was being charged $49.99 repeatedly for a subscription that I did NOT authorize. I found multiple charges on my Apple account, including 4/21/26, 5/22/26, 6/22/26, and 7/23/26, along with another attempted charge that was declined.

When I contacted the app about these charges, I was told they could not credit or refund me. Even worse, there is no way to speak with an actual person. The only customer support available is through a text/chat system on the app, which makes it incredibly frustrating when you are dealing with unauthorized charges.

I never knowingly authorized these recurring charges, and I am extremely unhappy with how this situation has been handled. If you use this app, please carefully monitor your Apple subscriptions and charges. I would not recommend this app based on my experience with the billing and customer service.

reviews.title: Great exercise app!
reviews.text: I LOVE this app! You can choose from several different types of exercises and get a 30-day plan set up based on your target areas (you can choose to target only certain spots or whole body). I’ve been doing 12-15 min Wall Pilates every morning for the past 2 years and I’ve lost 60lbs DURING perimenopause (I’m 48 - started at 198 & now down to 138). I feel and look better than I have in years. I also sprinkle in Tai Chi and there are meditation options as well. When I had a gym membership, I never went enough for it to be effective. But with this, you can do it at home (or anywhere) anytime!

reviews.title: Confusing
reviews.text:
TLDR; the app needs to be worked on, the company does work to resolve and refund very quickly, concept is great.
 I gave them stars for quick resolution and quality check of this. 

 The whole process of downloading the app from an advertisement has issues. This seems to be a common issue for the app; you click on what you think is your session and the app tells you that you need to add more content to your account to be able to access your content for use by you. 
The reason why this issue seems to be an ongoing concern? The FAQ has the faq of "why do I need to pay for more services , I just signed up?” Or something like this. I couldn’t navigate the site because of this.

reviews.title: Grandma
reviews.text:
I am 78 years old and thought I would try the program. But I couldn’t understand all the instructions and the system kept running erratically to where I couldn’t get the full understanding of the program. So I thought by deleting the app would just cancel everything. It did not and fees were deducted from my bank. I saw I absolutely could not afford the program at this time. After several conversations the company overrode their refund policy rules and refunded my money. This was such a kind thing to do. Now I can get my meds refilled when the money clears my bank. I found out of all of this that there are large companies out there that still have great compassion for the lives of we senior citizens that have given our all to the country we love. I will certainly try this program again someday when I find myself in a better financial position. I thank the Yoga-go
Support team that worked on this for the good of the company and for me. 
Sincerely…
